components.html: <button class="ds-btn-gradient"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.25" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 1 0 9-9 9.75 9.75 0 0 0-6.74 2.74L3 8"/><path d="M3 3v5h5"/></svg>重新整理</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-gradient { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 32px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Work Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom right, #10b981, #2dd4bf); box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(16,185,129,0.3); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-gradient:hover { transform: scale(1.03); box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(16,185,129,0.4); } .ds-btn-gradient:active { transform: scale(1.0); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Standard primary action. Solid emerald, 3px emerald focus ring.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Work Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #052e1a; background: oklch(0.7 0.17 150); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.66 0.17 150); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.7 0.17 150) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Transparent field with hairline border and an emerald focus glow.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; width: 240px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.338 0.042 262.181); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(30,41,59,0.3); color: oklch(0.985 0.002 247.839); font-family: 'Work Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; outline: none; transition: color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.704 0.04 256.788); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.7 0.17 150); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.7 0.17 150) 50%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: EasyAccounting is a personal finance and asset-management app, and its interface behaves the way a good ledger should: calm, ordered, and quietly premium. A near-black abyss or bright slate canvas holds a slow field of emerald/teal ambient glow, and the chrome — a floating glass header, a slide-in glass sidebar — hovers over it like frosted panels. The mood is Calm, Premium, Trustworthy: nothing shouts, everything is legible, and the single emerald accent does the pointing. Depth is built from translucency and soft light, not hard drop shadows.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (emerald→teal), spent sparingly; slate neutrals carry the rest.
Glass + ambient glow is the chrome signature — not applied to content cards.
Depth via translucency, blur, and tonal layering, not dark drop shadows.
OKLCH tokens, dark-default with a fully-realized light theme.
Geometric display (Outfit) vs. humanist body (Work Sans).

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Emerald (and its teal twin) is the only accent. If a screen needs a second 'color to mean something', use weight, size, or a neutral — not a new hue. Emerald stays on ≤10–15% of any screen.

rules.name: The Ghost Border Rule
rules.body: On glass chrome, borders are the neutral hairline at low alpha, never a solid opaque line.

rules.name: The Outfit-For-Voice Rule
rules.body: Outfit is reserved for brand and headings; body and dense data stay in Work Sans.

rules.name: The Frosted-Chrome Rule
rules.body: backdrop-blur belongs to structural chrome (header, sidebar, sheets, dialogs). Forbidden as decoration on content cards, rows, or metrics.

rules.name: The Glow-Is-Interactive Rule
rules.body: Colored emerald shadow means 'this is an action'. Neutral ambient shadow means 'this floats'.

dos: Do spend emerald sparingly (≤10–15% of a screen). It marks the one action that matters.
Do reserve backdrop-blur glass for chrome (header, sidebar, sheets, dialogs).
Do build depth from translucency, soft ambient shadow, and emerald glow on interactive accents.
Do keep body text at Muted Ink or darker — bump toward Ink if contrast is even close to 4.5:1.
Do use OKLCH tokens from globals.css; add insets via the --safe-area-* vars on mobile.
Do use the 3px emerald focus ring on every interactive control.
Do set headings in Outfit, body in Work Sans.
donts: Don't put glassmorphism on content cards, data rows, or metric tiles. Chrome only.
Don't introduce a second accent hue. Use weight, size, or a neutral for emphasis.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text); emphasis comes from weight and size.
Don't use a colored side-stripe as decoration. A 2px left border is allowed only as the sidebar active-state marker.
Don't ship hard, dark drop shadows. Shadows are large, soft, low-opacity, or absent.
Don't set body copy or dense data in Outfit.
Don't let muted-gray text drift lighter 'for elegance' — it fails contrast and reads as AI slop.
